findings.title: Report --data for an invalid summary supplied inside JSON
findings.body: For task +update --task-id task-1 --data '{"summary":null}' (also empty, whitespace or non-string summary), --summary was not supplied, but the new validation returns param="--summary". The invalid field came from --data. AGENTS.md and errs/ERROR_CONTRACT.md require param to name the failing user input; machine recovery is pointed at the wrong option. Preserve input provenance and report --data unless an explicit --summary override supplied the invalid value.
findings.evidence: Static deterministic trace: parseTaskObject populates taskObj at lines 178-183; absent --summary leaves it untouched at 191-196; validation at 216-219 unconditionally uses --summary. No command or test executed.
findings.test_gap: task_input_test.go tests create explicit empty summary and update empty description, and task_e2e_test.go tests null entire objects; neither asserts error.param for invalid summary inside update --data. Add both JSON-origin and explicit-override cases.
